metadata.title: सीता सोरेन पर भारी इरफ़ान अंसारी | Irfan Ansari Vs Sita Soren in Jamtara | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: The Jamtara Vidhan Sabha seat has a combination of Muslim and Adivasi voters and has long been a political stronghold for the Congress. In this election, the BJP has fielded Sita Soren, a tribal candidate, to sway Adivasi votes and wrest the seat away from Congress. However, the move appears to have backfired, as discontent brews among BJP’s local leaders and workers. Meanwhile, Irfan Ansari of Congress emerged as the clear favourite among the electorate. Watch our exclusive ground report from Jamtara for a closer look at the political dynamics shaping this high-stakes constituency.
